page.layout: One printed page of verse. Main text in one block at left, with a heading and verse below a rule. Marginal note at right beside the heading and first stanza. Signature mark at foot. A faint ghost of the facing page shows through at right and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Quòd juvas quoque tu, domi foràsque,Consiliarius Hassiacus & Brandeburgensis, &c.
Quæ Dei munera sunt: vocaris o quàm
main_text.head: FRANCISCVS CASTILLIONÆVS:
main_text.p: En en mihi tibi si STO, sicut INFANS
Quantum distat ab axe terra Olympi,
Quantum dissitus occidens ab ortu est.

page.notes: Verse is set in italic; capitals and small capitals as printed. Marginal note at right reads "Consiliarius Hassiacus & Brandeburgensis, &c." The rule above the heading separates the two sections. Several words in the ghosted facing page are not transcribed. Some letters in the ink are doubtful, notably "en en mihi tibi" and "annagrammatiq", which were read with uncertainty. The first note's placement beside the first line is approximate.
